template_metadata.name: Codebase Inventory Template
template_metadata.description: Template for documenting legacy/unknown codebase analysis results

inventory_date: REPLACE: ISO 8601 timestamp of inventory creation
source_root: REPLACE: Absolute path to analyzed codebase

languages_detected.language: REPLACE: Language name (e.g., python, java, go)
languages_detected.file_count: REPLACE: Number of files in this language
languages_detected.primary: REPLACE: true if this is the primary language, false otherwise
languages_detected.detection_method: REPLACE: How version was detected (config_file, syntax_analysis, shebang)

frameworks_detected.name: REPLACE: Framework name (e.g., django, spring, react)
usage_areas: REPLACE: List of usage areas (e.g., web_api, orm, testing)
frameworks_detected.detection_source: REPLACE: How it was detected (import_statement, config_file, file_pattern)

entry_points.type: REPLACE: Entry point type (main, wsgi, asgi, cli, api, scheduled_task)
entry_points.file: REPLACE: Path to file relative to source_root
entry_points.description: REPLACE: What this entry point does

files.type: REPLACE: Config type (env, yaml, json, python)

environment_variables.name: REPLACE: Environment variable name
usage_locations: REPLACE: List of files that reference this variable
environment_variables.appears_required: REPLACE: true if code fails without it, false/unknown otherwise
environment_variables.default_value: REPLACE: Default value if any, or null

directory_structure.pattern: REPLACE: Recognized pattern (django_standard, maven_standard, monorepo, etc.) or 'custom'

code_metrics.total_files: REPLACE: Total number of source files
code_metrics.total_lines: REPLACE: Total lines of code (excluding blanks/comments)
code_metrics.test_coverage_detected: REPLACE: Existing test coverage percentage if detectable, or null

largest_files.note: REPLACE: Any notes (may need refactoring, generated code, etc.)

complexity_indicators.max_function_length_detected: REPLACE: Lines in longest function found
complexity_indicators.max_class_size_detected: REPLACE: Lines in largest class found
complexity_indicators.cyclomatic_complexity_estimate: REPLACE: low, medium, high, or specific number

potential_issues_detected.issue_type: REPLACE: Type (dead_code, circular_import, large_file, no_tests, etc.)

limitations: REPLACE: List any limitations in the analysis (e.g., couldn't parse certain files)
manual_review_needed: REPLACE: Areas that need manual review
assumptions_made: REPLACE: Any assumptions made during analysis
